Change Trigger (User Story V1 → V2): US-01 (Leap Year): V1: Divisible by 4 rule only. → V2: Full Gregorian rule (century & 400 exception).
US-02 (Time Addition): V1: Simple addition. → V2: Proper overflow handling (sec→min→hour, 24h wrap).
US-03 (Time Subtraction): V1: Direct subtraction. → V2: Wrap across midnight safely.
US-04 (Formatting): V1: Basic string conversion. → V2: Zero-padded ISO format (HH:mm:ss).
US-05 (Comparison): V1: Compare hours & minutes only. → V2: Compare full precision (hours, minutes, seconds).
US-06 (Parsing): V1: Basic split parsing. → V2: Strict validation & whitespace trimming.
US-08 (Duration): V1: Direct subtraction. → V2: Support midnight crossing & second-level precision.
US-11 & US-12 (Immutability & Concurrency): V1: Mutable/shared instances. → V2: Immutable objects & thread-safe access.
